description: Source-qualified sanctions association and source-stated historical-status inquiries with explicit roles, selected reference revisions and amendment history. Matches never establish legal effect, status of another node, control, liability or accepted assessment.

source.description: Explicit source entity identity; source-qualified relations must independently establish every path.

purpose.description: Retrospective retains dated source reports and attached corrections. Historical modes ask source-stated status and relevant applicability, never legal effect.

period.description: Case-selected actual relationship applicability and/or status inquiry period; receipt and entity creation are not substitutes.

reference_sources.description: Exact supplied source revision IDs eligible for every required path record; no automatic all-history expansion.

entry_revisions.description: Exact revision-specific sanction:entry record IDs selected as reference, independently of activity dates.

at.description: Explicit case-selected point for source-stated relationship/list status; not analyst knowledge.

exclude_source_classes.description: Explicit reusable source policy; disabled by default. Unknown or conflicting membership is retained.

source_classes.description: Exact source-reported class IDs for a deliberately selected revision-based filter; neither historical membership nor universal clearance is inferred.

exclude_path_classes.description: Explicit reusable path policy; disabled by default. Unknown or conflicting membership is retained.

path_classes.description: Exact source-reported class IDs for a deliberately selected revision-based filter; neither historical membership nor universal clearance is inferred.

branches.description: Applicability of actual source-reported relationships; historical some requires a common supported state, not independent overlaps.

policies.reason: Explicit source classification policy over selected report revisions; no historical class membership, clearance or truth inferred.
